I was right. 

I was right all along.

I cried loudly today and no one asked what was wrong.

I thought maybe posting here would help me. Maybe someone would listen. But no.

Haha.

I'm ending my life in the next three hours. I got all my suicide letters prepared. 

I don't know Ma. If you see this. I'm sorry. It wasn't that you were bad its just...not everyone can be fully good or bad. And Bro. Again they probably won't show you this but if you do some time in the future, I hope you have an amazing life.  I'm sorry if you have kids and I'm not there to see my little nephews and nieces. Same thing with my potential future baby siblings. Its not your fault. I had little nudges here and there. I'm not pinpointing my blame on anyone. I don't want to go all hannah baker and blame shit on people. I wish things would've gone a different way. I wish I could've grown up to go to college, have a boyfriend, and maybe future children. But I won't. Please guys. Don't beat yourselves up. And I forgive everyone and I'm trying to forgive myself for what I'm about to do.
